fields.F1Comments: F1B—ALTHOUGH THERE WERE 99 TOTAL PRECINCTS ESTABLISHED IN LEE COUNTY FOR THE NOVEMBER 2022 GENERAL ELECTION, DUE TO THE IMPACT OF HURRICANE IAN AND LOSS OF NUMEROUS POLLING LOCATIONS, LEE COUNTY CONDUCTED VOTING UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER 22-234 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR DESANTIS. TWELVE EARLY VOTING SITES OPERATED FOR 16 DAYS THROUGH ELECTION DAY. THREE SITES WERE AT BRANCH LOCATIONS OF THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS. ONE ADDITIONAL EARLY VOTING SITE WAS PROVIDED ONLY ON ELECTION DAY FROM 7:00 AM UNTIL 7:00 PM IN BOCA GRANDE, FL. THREE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS OFFICES OFFERED EARLY VOTING AND ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING. THE SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS MAIN OFFICE WAS NOT A DESIGNATED EARLY VOTING SITE BUT OFFERED ABSENTEE BALLOT PICKUP/VOTING AND THEREFORE IS REPORTED IN D3A.
fields.F10Comments: F10A—F10E DUE TO THE IMPACT OF HURRICANE IAN AND LOSS OF NUMEROUS POLLING LOCATIONS, LEE COUNTY CONDUCTED VOTING UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER 22-234 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR DESANTIS. THE VOTING MODEL IN LEE COUNTY UTILIZED EARLY VOTING LOCATIONS THROUGH ELECTION DAY.
fields.F11: DUE TO THE IMPACT OF HURRICANE IAN AND LOSS OF NUMEROUS POLLING LOCATIONS, LEE COUNTY CONDUCTED VOTING UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER 22-234 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR DESANTIS. THE VOTING MODEL IN LEE COUNTY UTILIZED 12 EARLY VOTING LOCATIONS THROUGH ELECTION DAY.  THE AFTERMATH OF A NEAR CATEGORY FIVE HURRICANE DID NOT DETER VOTERS FROM MAKING THEIR VOICES HEARD. LEE COUNTY HAD A 53% VOTER TURNOUT, CONSISTENT WITH VOTER TURNOUT THROUGHOUT FLORIDA, AND AN ASTOUNDING NUMBER CONSIDERING THE CHALLENGES HURRICANE IAN PRESENTED FOR THE MANY VOTERS AFFECTED BY THE STORM AND ELECTION OPERATIONS.

NOTE THAT IN PRIOR SURVEYS, SECTION A DATA WAS PROVIDED BY THE FLORIDA DEPARTMENT OF STATE, DIVISION OF ELECTIONS, BASED ON QUERYING THE FLORIDA VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM MAIN DATABASE. FOR AN UNKNOWN REASON, THE DEPARTMENT DECLINED TO PROVIDE THE DATA FOR THE 2022 EAVS, AND INSTEAD DIRECTED INDIVIDUAL COUNTIES TO GATHER AND SUBMIT THE DATA THEMSELVES. BECAUSE OF THIS CHANGE IN METHODOLOGY, THERE MAY BE INCONSISTENCES WHEN COMPARING THE 2022 DATA WITH THE DATA FROM PRIOR SURVEYS.
